items.title: Announcement of prohibition of sound producing devices during the meeting
Approval of Minutes of April 5, 2022 Regular Meeting
Introduction of New or Unfinished Business by Board Members
All matters listed hereunder constitute a Consent Calendar, are considered to be routine by the SFMTA Board of Directors and will be acted upon by a single vote
Requesting the Controller to allot funds and to draw warrants against such funds available or will be available in payment
Adopting the Muni Service Equity Strategy Report for Fiscal Years 2023 and 2024
Amending the Transportation Code, Division II, Section 702 to reduce the speed limit from 25 miles per hour to 20 miles per hour
Approving the SFMTA’s Fiscal Year 2023-2027 Capital Improvement Program in the amount of $2.6 billion
Approving various actions related to the SFMTA two-year Fiscal Year (FY) 2023 and 2024 Budget including approving the SFMTA FY 2023 and FY 2024 Operating Budget and the Capital Budget
Authorizing the Director to execute Contract No. SFMTA-2022-13, for Parking Meter Coin and Parking Data Collection Services, with LAZ Parking California
Discussion and vote pursuant to Administrative Code Section 67.10(d) as to whether to invoke the attorney-client privilege and conduct a closed session conference with legal counsel
Motion to disclose or not disclose the information discussed in closed session
